title: Risk of Rain: online testing on OpenPak
body: Risk of Rain is a fast roguelite where the clock keeps ticking and every run plays out differently. OpenPak's online service for the Switch version is up, so the game has a server to reach for its online features. Compatibility testing is still ongoing, so treat online play as a test for now and tell us what you see.
footer: OpenPak Risk of Rain — in testing, not promised.
